### 5 Truths About God's Blessings Over You (Numbers 6:24-26) - Your Daily Bible Verse - December 26
Author: Lisa Appelo
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/5-truths-about-god-s-blessings-over-you-bible-study-minute-december-20-2017.html
Passage: Numbers 6:24-26
Points:
- God Himself is the true initiator and source of every blessing spoken over His people.
- The blessing repeatedly uses the singular "you," showing God cares for and blesses each believer individually.
- The Hebrew idea of blessing depicts God stooping down to share His benefits and Himself.
- God lifting His countenance resembles an affectionate father beaming with joy over his child.
- The promised peace (shalom) extends beyond the absence of conflict to completeness, safety, and wholeness.

### The Lord Bless You and Keep You
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-lord-bless-you-and-keep-you
Passage: Numbers 6:24-26
Points:
- The threefold repetition of Yahweh highlights God Himself as the heart and focus of the blessing.
- God's shining face expresses His gracious movement toward believers to bestow unmerited favor.
- God keeping His people emphasizes His ongoing protection and guardianship over their lives.
- The blessing culminates in biblical shalom, offering comprehensive well-being and flourishing in God's presence.
- By placing His name upon His people, God marks them as His own and guarantees His commitment to preserve them.
